questions.prompt: What does an async function return when it returns a value?

options.text: A Promise that resolves to the value
A Promise that rejects with the value
Nothing, async functions always return undefined

questions.explanation: Async functions always return a Promise that resolves to the returned value.

questions.prompt: Which statement about the event loop is true?

options.text: Microtasks are executed after every macrotask
Microtasks are executed after the current call stack is empty but before the next macrotask
The event loop only processes microtasks

questions.explanation: Microtasks are processed after the current stack empties and before the next macrotask.

questions.prompt: What is the result of Promise.allSettled([Promise.reject('error'), Promise.resolve(42)])?

options.text: A Promise that resolves to an array [{"status":"rejected","reason":"error"},{"status":"fulfilled","value":42}]
A Promise that resolves to an array [42, 'error']
A Promise that resolves to an array [{"status":"fulfilled","value":42},{"status":"rejected","reason":"error"}]

questions.explanation: Promise.allSettled returns an array of objects with status and value or reason for each promise.
